description: React component for managing and displaying a list of categories with add, edit, and context menu functionalities, integrated with Redux state management.

methods.name: _setCategoryEdit
methods.description: Dispatches action to set the current category being edited.

methods.name: _updateCategory
methods.description: Dispatches action to update a category.

methods.name: _addCategory
methods.description: Dispatches action to add a new category.

methods.name: onAddCategory
methods.description: Handles the event to add a new category, opens category list and sets temp state.

methods.name: handleCategoryMenuClick
methods.description: Handles right-click or menu click on a category, manages context menu positioning and selection.

methods.name: handleCategoryRightClick
methods.description: Prevents default context menu and triggers custom menu handling.

methods.name: onSubmitUpdateCategory
methods.description: Handles submission of category update, validates, and dispatches update.

methods.name: onSubmitNewCategory
methods.description: Handles submission of new category, validates, and dispatches add.
